title: Schedule types in EventBridge Scheduler
note: Lesson 2.1 addition for task 2.1 questions (K05, distractor for q-saa-2-1-k05-mc/mr): fetched from docs.aws.amazon.com and confirmed EventBridge Scheduler supports rate-based, cron-based, and one-time schedules that invoke a target on a time-driven schedule you configure, distinct from an EventBridge rule, which reacts to a matching event.
